lines.li: [them] You were one of those who broke that camp, weren't you?
[us] I was there, yes.
[them,their:lowtech] The road to our town is open again because of it, and the elders know your name.
[them] Our carts use that road again because of it, and people at home know your name.
[us] It needed doing.
[them] Plenty of things need doing, and nobody does them.
[them] Our fighters still talk about the day you stood with them.
[us] I hope they tell it kindly.
[them,their:tribal] They tell it at the fire, and you are always in it.
[them] They tell it every time someone buys them a drink.
[us] Then I'll buy the next one.
[them] You're the one who trades at our post, the traders there know you.
[us] They drive a hard bargain.
[them] They say the same about you, and they mean it as praise.
[them] You walked our settlers out to their new land, didn't you?
[us] All the way, and back again.
[them] They still talk about that road, and who walked it with them.
[us] Tell them I asked after them.
[them,you:foe:killed] I know your face, you killed one of ours.
[them,you:foe:executed] You're the one who put one of ours to death in your cells.
[them,you:foe:harvested] You're the one who cut one of ours open for parts.
[them,you:foe:insulted] I know you, you threw hard words at one of ours.
[them] I know what you did to one of ours, and so does everyone at home.
[us] Then there's nothing more to say.
[them] Is {FOE} still at the colony?
[us] Why do you ask?
[them,their:foe:killed] My people haven't forgotten the one of ours {FOE} killed, that's all.
[them,their:foe:executed] My people haven't forgotten the one of ours {FOE} put to death.
[them] My people haven't forgotten what {FOE} did, that's all.
[us] It was a hard time, for all of us.
[them] Hard times end, and names stay.
[them] I'll trade with you, but not with {FOE}, you understand.
[us] I understand why.
[them] Good, then we'll get on.
